name: Kenco MCS Jeffersonville I - Jeffersonville IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Sliding chain-link gate across the NW dock-yard truck driveway, confirmed in Street View (2026-03). Gate opening set in continuous perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth of any kind beside the gate; entrance is a fence opening only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated entry with no guard shack implies kiosk/app/remote check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks: a long bank on the NW (back) face plus a separate dock bank mid-way along the SE face.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron on the NW driveway with room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Roster source cites 113 dock doors for this 664,800 SF AutoStore site; NW face long bank plus SE-face bank are consistent with 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Deep paved drop yard along the NW dock apron holds many parked trailers; estimate 25-50 stalls.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: River Ridge Commerce Center is an edge-of-town greenfield industrial park surrounded by farmland; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~35 trailers counted in NW dock apron z19/z20 imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated 90 from drop-yard depth; low confidence.

citations.claim: Kenco newsroom: AutoStore live at its Jeffersonville IN DC (49,000 bins / 130 robots)
River Ridge Development Authority lists Kenco at 201 River Ridge Parkway, scalable to 660,000+ SF

verification.rationale: Tier-1 self-attested current operation at the exact address; AutoStore live Aug 2024, DC opened Sept 2024; no closure signal.
